limitations: Stage 1 introduction/entrance uses power-on controller-only input; stages 2..8 have one declared stage-index intervention.
The dedicated exit/interlude captures use explicit scene input interventions. They are not natural Boss victories. Root full-world traces provide separate naturally executed combat evidence.
Controlled cases are function input matrices, not continuous game traversal. No recorded after-state or emulator is used by Go implementation.
Raster mask/control and split-scroll commands require the owning World/render pipeline; local scene tests do not certify browser rendering or a full eight-stage game.
